crossRefs.note: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from…
But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

translations.web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
translations.bsb: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me; I too will declare what I know.’
translations.kjv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
translations.asv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will show mine opinion.
